draft.briefing: Hey, you're in Deccan Gymkhana! This whole area is named after the Deccan Gymkhana sports club, founded in 1906, whose grounds have hosted Davis Cup tennis matches.
draft.hungryLine: FC Road and JM Road are lined with budget eateries serving hot food, and while you're in Pune, try a misal if you can take the spice.

moodReplies.show-me-around: The Deccan Gymkhana Ground is 2 minutes away, the old Ranade Institute is 6 minutes on foot, and Fergusson College is about 15 minutes away.
moodReplies.somewhere-to-chill: Walk 12 minutes to Kamala Nehru Park, 10 acres of lawns with a fountain, a jogging track and even an old HF-24 Marut jet parked on the grass.
moodReplies.surprise-me: The Deccan Gymkhana metro station's design is inspired by the Mavala Pagadi, the turban of Shivaji Maharaj.

spots.name: Deccan Gymkhana Ground
spots.detail: 2 min walk · The 1906 club that gave the area its name, with 11 tennis courts and a cricket ground

spots.name: Vaishali
spots.detail: 9 min walk · A Pune favourite for South Indian food on Fergusson College Road

spots.name: Fergusson College
spots.detail: 15 min walk · Founded in 1885 by Tilak, Agarkar and friends

tips.title: Plan around Ganeshotsav.
tips.body: Around September the city celebrates Ganeshotsav for ten days and the city interiors are almost blocked, so expect crowds.

tips.title: Take the metro.
tips.body: The Aqua Line stops at Deccan Gymkhana, and a skywalk from the J. M. Road bus stop takes you straight up to the station.

story.title: Sadashiv Peth is laid out
story.body: Next door, Madhavrao I founded Sadashiv Peth in honour of Sadashivrao Bhau. It was first planned for the military, in squares with broad streets.

story.title: Fergusson College
story.body: Bal Gangadhar Tilak, Gopal Ganesh Agarkar and others founded the college, naming it after Sir James Fergusson, the Governor of Bombay.

story.title: The Gymkhana is born
story.body: Balkrishna Narayan Bhajekar led the founding of the Deccan Gymkhana and its grounds in October 1906. The club later hosted Davis Cup matches.

story.title: Madras Cafe opens
story.body: Jagannath B Shetty started a restaurant on Fergusson College Road as Madras Cafe. Today it's Vaishali, and hundreds of people eat there every day.

story.title: Metro by the river
story.body: The Deccan Gymkhana metro station opened on 1 August 2023 on the banks of the Mutha River, part of the Aqua Line.

food.name: Hindavi Swarajya Fruits & Juices
food.detail: Fresh juices on JM Road, opposite JM mandir

food.name: Shree Uphar Gruha
food.detail: A small joint at Tulsi Baug in the Peth areas, go for the misal and fritters
